task: ae.search: negamax alpha-beta with transposition table, ordering and iterative deepening over ConnectK and subtraction-Nim, checked against a minimax oracle
reasoning_summary: Terminal scores are +-(WIN-ply), a function of the position alone, so the transposition table needs no mate correction. Alpha-beta is verified by exact equality with an unpruned minimax oracle (no table at any depth, with table at full depth, one table reused across searches and depths). A 14-mutant check killed every mutant after adding two tests for shallow-entry reuse and root window narrowing.
